name: intelthreadlinqs-mcp
description: 25 cyber-threat-intelligence tools — threats, SPL/KQL/Sigma detections, IOCs, actors, C2, MITRE ATT&CK. Purple and Gold in full; a free account has a daily allowance.
long_description:
Threadlinqs Intelligence is a cyber-threat-intelligence MCP server. It exposes 25 tools, each covering a family through a view or sections argument, across curated threats, detection logic (Splunk SPL / Microsoft KQL / Sigma), IOCs, threat actors, C2 infrastructure, MITRE ATT&CK chains, CVE/CWE and correlations, plus prompts, resources, completions and STIX 2.1 / ATT&CK Navigator export. Every earlier tool name stays callable, though it is no longer listed. The tool list you see is whatever the platform serves when the server starts, so it follows the platform without a new release.

Purple and Gold have full access. A free account (verified email) has a daily allowance of tool calls; bundles, daily briefs and exports are refused on it before they spend anything, and single lookups stay open. An agent key (tla_) works once a person has claimed it, with that person's plan. The server starts without a key so clients and registries can introspect the catalog, but every tool CALL is gated server-side and needs a valid key; there is no anonymous access to intelligence data. Get a key at https://intel.threadlinqs.com/profile; plans are on the pricing page.

Prefer zero-install? The same server is available as a remote connector at https://intel.threadlinqs.com/mcp (OAuth 2.1).
